description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of a snowy surface with a pair of black skis and two ski poles resting on the snow. The skis are positioned parallel to each other, pointing toward the top of the frame, with their tips slightly angled outward. They have white and gray markings, including a logo near the tip of the right ski. The snow appears smooth and undisturbed except for faint tracks and shadows cast by the skis and poles. One ski pole is visible
